intro.en: Illness and treatment in the language of the doctor's surgery and the leaflet in the box.

marearse.en: to feel dizzy; to get travel-sick

texto.en:
**Symptoms.** **Tengo mareos**, **náuseas**, **escalofríos**, **malestar general**. **Me mareo** en el coche. **Me encuentro decaído.** **He perdido el apetito.**

**At the surgery.** The doctor **te toma la tensión**, **te hace un análisis de sangre**, **una radiografía**, **una ecografía** or **un chequeo**, gives **un diagnóstico** and **te receta** un medicamento. You may be sent to **un especialista**: **el traumatólogo**, **el pediatra**, **el dermatólogo**.

**Illnesses.** **Una enfermedad leve**, **grave**, **crónica**, **contagiosa**, **hereditaria**. **Tener la tensión alta**, **el colesterol alto**, **azúcar**. **Sufrir un infarto**. Formal verbs: **padecer** and **sufrir** una enfermedad.

**Passing it on.** Me **has contagiado** la gripe. **Me he contagiado.** **Vacunarse contra** la gripe.

**Injuries.** **Hacerse un esguince**, **torcerse el tobillo**, **romperse** un hueso. They **te escayolan** el brazo, **te ponen una venda**, **te dan puntos**, and **te queda una cicatriz**.

**The leaflet.** **El prospecto** gives **la dosis recomendada**, **las contraindicaciones** and **los efectos secundarios**. A medicine may be **un calmante**, **un analgésico**, **un antiinflamatorio**, **una pomada** or **una inyección**.

**Health in general.** **Estar a dieta** or **a régimen**, **cuidarse**, **reponer fuerzas**, **tener una salud de hierro**.

frases.es: Bajando una escalera me torcí el tobillo, y como no podía apoyar el pie, fui a urgencias.
frases.en: Going down some stairs I twisted my ankle, and as I could not put my weight on the foot, I went to casualty.
analisis: como no podía apoyar el pie

frases.es: Me hicieron una radiografía y el traumatólogo me dijo que no era más que un esguince.
frases.en: They took an X-ray and the orthopaedic doctor told me it was only a sprain.
analisis: no era más que un esguince

frases.es: No hizo falta escayolarme: me pusieron una venda y me recetaron un antiinflamatorio.
frases.en: There was no need to put me in plaster: they bandaged me and prescribed an anti-inflammatory.

frases.es: Sin embargo, al tomarme la tensión, la enfermera vio que la tenía muy alta.
frases.en: However, on taking my blood pressure, the nurse saw that it was very high.

frases.es: Yo no había notado ningún síntoma, salvo algún mareo al que no había dado importancia.
frases.en: I had not noticed any symptoms, except the odd dizzy spell to which I had given no importance.
analisis: al que no había dado importancia

frases.es: Tras varias pruebas me dieron el diagnóstico: una enfermedad crónica, pero leve si se sigue el tratamiento.
frases.en: After several tests they gave me the diagnosis: a chronic illness, but a mild one if the treatment is followed.

frases.es: Ahora leo el prospecto de cada pastilla, y debo reconocer que, de no haberme caído, no me habría enterado.
frases.en: Now I read the leaflet for every pill, and I must admit that, had I not fallen, I would not have found out.

pregunta.en: According to the text, what was wrong with the ankle?

It was only sprained.en: No era más que un esguince.

pregunta.en: According to the text, how was the chronic illness discovered?

The nurse took his blood pressure.en: Al tomarme la tensión, vio que la tenía muy alta.

The X-ray showed it.en: The X-ray was for the ankle.

pregunta.en: Where do you read about side effects?
Complete: the doctor prescribed me an antibiotic.

enfermo.en: Marearse is the verb for this.

bloques.frase: De no haberme caído, no me habría enterado.

texto.en: If I hadn't fallen, I wouldn't have found out.
By not falling, I had not understood.

explicacion.en: De + infinitive is a condition: if I had not…

texto.en: Because I didn't fall, I found out.

traduccion.en: They gave him five stitches in his forehead.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an opinion article on the health system of your country: strengths, weaknesses and proposals.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Explain aloud a medical problem you or someone close has had: symptoms, tests, diagnosis and treatment.
